tasks.short: Prepare and review method-transfer protocols and reports.

steps.what: Read the method and assemble transfer criteria and results
Assemble protocol fields and transfer-result tables
Write transfer narrative from the selected technical findings

loop.input: Controlled method text, selected transfer findings and source-linked result tables
loop.output: Transfer narrative with every claim linked to supplied evidence
loop.check: s4 checks numerical fidelity, method intent, omissions, acceptance criteria and unsupported conclusions
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; absent evidence or altered criteria returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native table templates first. Free-text differences between sending and receiving laboratories need explanation that cannot be safely inferred from a table merge.

steps.what: Review technical meaning and correct the final transfer document
Approve the final controlled transfer document
Release the approved transfer document in the controlled store

tasks.design: Use native laboratory-report templates in the laboratory-system category of {OTHER} to assemble controlled tables into {DOCS}. A bounded loop drafts narrative only from selected findings; the analyst checks technical meaning, then the quality reviewer approves and releases the final document.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tables and narrative are repeatedly rebuilt from the same transfer evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured report templates and bounded source-linked drafting can reuse that evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Equivalence, deviations and acceptance criteria require accountable technical review.
tasks.human_edge: Detect a transfer that appears numerically acceptable but changes the method's meaning.
tasks.altitude: Less document assembly; interpretation and quality release rights remain separate.

build_days.consent_and_access: 5-15 for validation, controlled access and applicable national consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured laboratory data can populate report tables; a source-grounded narrative draft still needs technical and quality review.

assumptions: Boundary: preparation, technical review and quality release of transfer documentation, not performing transfer experiments. Focal baseline is 80 workflow points; reviewer 20 points is outside role savings and fully retained.

Existing approved method and transfer runs supply method_id, version, sample_id, run_id, result, unit, acceptance_limit and deviation_reference. s1 selects findings and captures missing references manually. Unstructured or absent fields keep manual table preparation rather than invented data.
Test native report templates first. s4 produces the corrected final document before s5 approves it. s6 is near-zero same-system release at minimum 1%, fully retained.
B=80, R=52, gross 35%; focal upkeep 1.5 gives central net 33.5%. Reviewer upkeep is separately priced and not treated as system runtime.
unknowns: Required independent review and release roles
research_questions: Can reviewers trace every conclusion and acceptance criterion to the source packet?

incremental.description: Audit draft fidelity and maintain source mappings

approvals.approved_version: approved transfer document v1 final text, tables and source manifest; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% when reports are already generated and no drafting change is deployed; 28% when incomplete source fields add 5.5 focal hours per 100 baseline hours beyond central net 33.5%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review contract-laboratory data for accuracy and compliance.

steps.what: Retrieve the laboratory result packet and agreed test requirements
Capture reported results and evidence references for comparison

loop.input: Contract laboratory report pages with table and footnote locations
loop.output: Results, units, methods, limits and qualifiers linked to source spans
loop.check: Analyst checks every relied-on field and qualifier against the report, especially decimal signs, units and footnotes
loop.stop: One extraction; illegible pages, missing provenance or inconsistent units return to manual capture
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native structured imports first; a bounded extraction handles varying report layouts only when no agreed machine-readable feed exists.

steps.what: Compare reported identifiers, units and results with explicit requirements
Assess scientific validity, omissions and applicable compliance evidence
Record and verify the final review conclusion
Commit the approved laboratory review record

tasks.design: Test native structured imports in the laboratory-system category of {OTHER}; use checked bounded extraction only for variable report documents from {PARTNER_PORTAL}. Deterministic comparisons flag declared mismatches, while the analyst reviews scientific and compliance meaning and approves the final review record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Contract laboratories return different report layouts and qualifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Checked extraction can produce comparable fields while retaining source provenance.
tasks.still_hard: A complete table does not prove method validity, data integrity or compliance.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise missing evidence and challenge a superficially satisfactory result.

ambition.what: Check report-unit and qualifier consistency for each received contract-lab packet.

tasks.altitude: Less re-entry and mechanical comparison; scientific review remains central.

reach.learn: Method validity and supplier data-integrity checks

build_days.consent_and_access: 4-15 for supplier data access, validation and national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded extraction plus explicit comparisons can reduce report re-entry, without establishing scientific or regulatory validity.

assumptions: Boundary: received data review and its record, excluding supplier testing, supplier correction and final product release. Supplier packet production is unchanged and not credited as saving.

Supplier reports supply sample_id, method_id/version, result, unit, qualifiers and report_version; existing contract owners supply required_method, limits and required_evidence. s2 captures and checks all relied-on values; missing criteria or qualifiers retain manual review.
Use native imports and validation first. s3 performs only explicit identity/unit/limit checks; compliance judgement stays in s4. s6 is a near-zero native save at minimum 1%, fully retained.
unknowns: Variable report layouts and existing structured feeds
Actual mechanical review versus scientific-review effort
research_questions: Does extraction preserve censoring, footnotes and unit qualifiers?

already_counted.description: Check extracted fields against every relied-on source location

incremental.description: Audit extraction failures and maintain comparison rules

approvals.approved_version: approved laboratory review v1 final findings and source report version; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% with an existing validated feed and checks and no new tool; 25% when illegible reports and qualifier corrections consume 5.5 extra baseline hours versus central net 30.5%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and qualify new testing methods.

steps.what: Define the analytical purpose and qualification criteria
Design new testing methods and qualification experiments
Perform the planned laboratory experiments
Capture and verify actual raw observations and run references
Commit the verified raw observations
Calculate precision, bias and other specified qualification statistics
Judge method fitness against the complete experimental evidence
Write and verify the qualification report
Save the verified qualification report

tasks.design: Configure validated statistical presets and report tables in the laboratory-system category of {OTHER}, carrying results into the {DOCS} qualification template. The analyst designs and performs experiments, verifies actual observations and judges fitness; the software only computes the specified statistics and formats tables.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated selection of run data, formulas and report-table layouts.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated native analysis presets can reuse explicit experiment identifiers and formulas.
tasks.still_hard: Novel methods and failed experiments need scientific redesign.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether the evidence supports the method's intended use.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive analysis setup; bench work and qualification decisions remain unchanged.

build_days.consent_and_access: 4-15 for validation and controlled access plus national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: validated calculation presets can reduce repeated run selection and formula setup without replacing experimental work or fitness judgement.

assumptions: Boundary: analyst method development and qualification report, excluding subsequent organisational authorisation for routine use. Experiments and raw observation capture retain all effort.

s2 supplies experiment_id, replicate, analyte, reference_value and required_statistic. s4 captures actual run_id, observed_response, unit and deviations. s6 checks selected observations against the plan; missing runs or unvalidated formulas retain manual analysis.

Test native validated presets first. Existing instrument/calculator runtime earns no saving; s6 saving requires actual repeated human data-selection/formula setup. s8 changes only table and heading assembly.
s5 and s9 are near-zero same-system saves, minimum 1% each fully retained. Gross 10.8%; focal upkeep 1 gives central net 9.8%.
research_questions: Do preset outputs match an independent calculation on representative and failed runs?

already_counted.description: Check selected data and calculated statistics
Write and verify qualification conclusions and report

approvals.approved_version: approved raw observations v1 exact observed run data; edits void approval
approved qualification report v1 final tables and conclusions; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% if validated presets already cover all repeated setup and no change is installed; 7% if unusual experiment layouts retain 2.8 extra baseline hours versus central net 9.8%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate testing with contract laboratories and vendors.

steps.what: Establish sample, method, deadline and reporting requirements
Prepare the laboratory test-request message and sample schedule
Verify and approve the final test request and recipient
Send the approved request to the contract laboratory
Discuss laboratory capacity, clarify exceptions and agree testing arrangements
Record and verify the agreed methods, dates and responsibilities
Save the verified coordination record

tasks.design: Configure a sample-linked test-request template in the laboratory-system category of {OTHER} and a gated send through {EMAIL}. Keep laboratory discussions with the analyst, then reuse sample and method references in the internal coordination record while manually capturing the actual agreement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sample and method details are repeatedly copied into requests and coordination notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked templates and mail controls can reuse the same verified references.
tasks.still_hard: Capacity, unusual methods and deadline trade-offs need live agreement.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve misunderstandings before samples or results become unusable.
tasks.altitude: Less request assembly; supplier negotiation and commitments stay with the analyst.

reach.learn: Sample logistics and laboratory capability limits

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-8 for contact permissions and applicable national consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: sample-linked forms can reuse known request fields; laboratory capacity and exceptions still need coordination.

assumptions: Boundary: analyst request preparation, send, discussion and internal agreement record. Supplier reply and testing effort are unchanged outside the focal denominator, with no transfer to supplier self-service.

Existing sample records supply sample_id, material, quantity and handling_condition; approved methods supply method_id/version. s1 selects due_date and required_report_fields. Contact owners maintain recipient. s5 produces actual agreement; s6 manually captures agreed_date, exception and responsibility. Missing fields retain manual work.
Test native templates first. No automatic supplier commitment, purchase or follow-up send is proposed. s7 is a near-zero same-system save at minimum 1%, fully retained.
Gross saving 14.8%; focal upkeep 0.8 gives central net 14%.
unknowns: Actual repeated request entry and separate-send effort
research_questions: Does the request make method version and sample handling unambiguous?

incremental.description: Maintain request fields and approved contact links

approvals.approved_version: approved test request v1 final message, schedule and laboratory recipient; changes void approval
approved coordination record v1 reflecting actual agreed dates and responsibilities; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% where requests and notes are already linked and no change is deployed; 11% if unusual handling requirements retain three more baseline hours versus central net 14%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce document assembly, report re-entry and repeated calculations while retaining experiments, scientific review and supplier discussions.
role.ambitious_version: A quality control analyst who can trace each conclusion to actual observations and spend less time rebuilding the same evidence in different formats.
